verdict.rationale: Paxos documents programmatic stablecoin transfers with a Transfers API supporting listing and get-transfer status polling, orchestration webhooks with high-level and granular status events, retry logic up to 24 hours, and settlement to bank/fiat via redeem orchestration — covering send, track, and settle end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and no explicit example showing a raw wallet-address payout (vs. stored recipient/account) in the cited endpoints.
